def modular_exponentiation(base, exponent, modulus):
    """Compute (base ^ exponent) mod modulus using modular exponentiation."""
    if exponent < 0:
        raise ValueError("Exponent must be non-negative.")
    elif exponent == 0:
        return 1
    else:
        result = 1
        base = base % modulus
        while exponent > 0:
            if exponent % 2 == 1:
                result = (result * base) % modulus
            exponent = exponent // 2
            base = (base * base) % modulus
        return result

def compute_shared_secret(p, g, private_key):
    """Compute the shared secret using Diffie-Hellman key exchange."""
    public_key = modular_exponentiation(g, private_key, p)
    shared_secret = modular_exponentiation(public_key, private_key, p)
    return shared_secret

    server_public_key = modular_exponentiation(g, server_private_key, p)
